digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport retry
propositions: Jira Data Center rate limiting (8.6+, DC only, off by default) returns 429 with Retry-After header but rebar's DC transport does not honour it, causing hard failures on the first occurrence
A 429 retry must be scoped to idempotent reads only, defaulting to OFF per-call, to prevent reintroducing duplicate-issue failures when retrying mutations after the server has begun a write
The Retry-After header value must be parsed, jittered by up to 20%, and clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S, reusing existing _errors.parse_retry_after and MAX_BACKOFF_S rather than implementing a second parser

The rate-limit retry flag must reach the retry layer via two independent code paths: (PATH A) _paged_search → _call_logged → _with_connection_retry and (PATH B) get_comment_map's per-issue fetch via direct _with_connection_retry call, because PATH A alone would miss the highest-volume read

Cap exhaustion must raise BackendHTTPError with code 429 (never raw JIRAError) to preserve the adapter boundary contract and allow core exception handlers to classify DC failures identically to Cloud failures

All ten mutation call sites (create_issue, update_issue, add_comment, add_label, remove_label, transition_issue_by_name, set_relationship, delete_issue, delete_issue_link, set_parent) must fail immediately on the first 429, asserted per member rather than sampled
